subject: how DarwinGame's tournament narrows a large pool of candidate configurations down to one winner through four differently-styled phases

groups.why_chosen: Four tournament phases drawn as four completely different population shapes — grid, cluster blob, cycle graph, pair — unified only by one green-dot 'winner' colour and one repeated transition icon.
groups.what_to_learn: Let each phase's container shape mimic its tournament format — grid of pools, two-region blob, cyclic graph, simple pair — but keep the winner dot's colour and transition-icon arrow identical everywhere so the eye tracks one shrinking population.
